authenticationKey.title: authenticationKey
authenticationKey.description: Stores the authentication key used for verification code generation for the specified email address and is available as output from the flow.

customerId.title: customerId
customerId.description: Stores the user id or contact id

customerType.title: customerType
customerType.description: Stores the ID type, whether it is a User or a Contact

verificationCode.title: verificationCode
verificationCode.description: Stores the verification code generated for the specified email address and is available as output from the flow.

verificationMessage.title: verificationMessage
verificationMessage.description: Stores generic message that will be displayed to user
